name: What is kitchen light rail molding and do I need it?

mainEntity.name: What is kitchen light rail molding and do I need it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Light rail molding, also called under-cabinet trim, is installed along the lower bottom edge of upper kitchen cabinets to conceal task lighting strips and wiring. A key decision factor is the fixture type: low-profile tape LEDs require only a minimal one-inch molding, while bulkier plug-in puck lights or transformers need deeper two- to three-inch profiles. In addition to hiding wiring, light rails direct fixture glare downward onto the countertop rather than outward into the room, while adding a balanced, finished architectural look to the lower cabinetry perimeter.
acceptedAnswer.description: Light rail molding is decorative trim installed under upper cabinets to hide lighting fixtures and wiring while shielding your eyes from direct glare.
